item.title: Meyn Poultry Equipment Gets Spraypainted, Locks Glued (Basingstoke, UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: This global company was targeted for their manufacture and supply of animal abusing/exploiting/killing machinery. This was my first action so unfortunately adrenaline got the better of me and I ended up making a spelling mistake, still I think they got the message, a lock was also glued up.
